risk_note: RV2 by path (orders/**, admin/application, app.module.ts, contracts). Read-only admin order list and detail: GET /admin/v1/orders (filters, page paging) and GET /admin/v1/orders/{order_id} mounted in OrdersAdminModule.forAdmin (B1-10j precedent), x-implementation planned removed with the shape unchanged (codegen). Detail: status history, commission snapshot, latest 50 link logs, flags, phone masked through identity's read port, admin names through admin's, raw payload never returned, no audit on reads; unmapped_pending_open only from open UNMAPPED_STATUS pending records and last_hold_* only from manual order_hold audits, null while a system UNMAPPED hold is current (D10-169 K-7); order.view, and user.lookup only with a user_id (04 §11.2). The commission_splits and link_logs reads sit in app.module (composition root, countOrders / adminClaimPorts precedent), judged not S1 by the money review. No writes, no amounts computed. Codex was unavailable until 10-30, so the rule tests were written and the money review run by fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
